publication.interpretation: The author-institution abstract identifies Bcmfs1 in Botrytis cinerea and relates its expression and compound accumulation to oxpoconazole sensitivity. This supports reference discovery, not an exact resistant allele or tested-isolate accession.

access_accounting.basis: Destination explicitly recorded in the earlier HTTP 302 response, requested once as a new scoped follow-up.

reference_limits: The paper and native entry name Bcmfs1, but no explicit MFS1-to-Bcmfs1 alias is established by the inspected evidence. Q9P8L8 is a publication-qualified lead, not a qualified CARD determinant mapping; bounded source-term coverage does not increase.
Eight B05.10 entries carry the same native gene name at different ORFs; no representative is chosen from those annotations.

Q9P8L8 carries the paper PMID and DOI together, but its native bibliography has a SAS56 strain comment. Neither this comment nor the separate B05.10 entries establishes the identity of a tested resistant derivative.
The prior complete exact MFS1 query was empty. It remains valid for that query and is not protein absence or an alias-complete search.
No equivalence of all MFS1, Bcmfs1 or MFS-family annotations is inferred.
Indexed NCBI search results were not opened or used as primary evidence. No NCBI endpoint request was made.
